clauses.text:
1-101. Establishment of Board. There is established a board of three mem­
bers to be appointed by the President to investigate this dispute. No member  
of the board shall be pecuniarily or otherwise interested in any organization of  
railroad employees or any carrier.

1-102. Report. The board shall report its finding to the President with  
respect to the dispute within 30 days from the date of this Order.

1-103. Maintaining Conditions. As provided by Section 10 of the Railway  
Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for 30 days after the board has  
made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be  
made by the Norfolk and Western Railway Company, or by its employees, in  
the conditions out of which the dispute arose.

versions.research_rationale:
EO 12085 (Creating an emergency board to investigate a dispute between the Norfolk and Western Railway Company and certain of its employees), signed 1978-09-28. The order creates an emergency board under Section 10 of the Railway Labor Act for a dispute between the Norfolk and Western Railway Company and certain employees; Section 1-101 establishes a board of three members. First end: Section 3 of EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, Termination of Boards, Committees, and Commissions) names this order by number, "Executive Order No. 12085," and provides that it is revoked. EO 12379 has no effective-date clause, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1982-08-17.  Machine searches adopted after reading their coverage notes: the U.S. Code search (release point 119-121, 0 hits for this order), the eCFR search as of 2026-10-14 (0 hits) and the Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition-note search (2 hits). They are leads only; the end, the later events and the savings were decided from the held Federal Register texts named in this claim. Search of the held order texts for this order's number (the packet records a bounded number-citation search over its lookup corpus, excluding clause-draft copies): apart from the order's own copies, the matching files are EO 11022, EO 11256, EO 11829, EO 12379. The files filed under EO 11022, EO 11256 and EO 11829 matched only because they carry the same Federal Register pages as the EO 12379 revocation list; they are not separate instruments naming this order.
